create_AppendTokenDataset: create an AppendTokenDataset that appends a specified token to each item in a wrapped dataset
build_AppendTokenDataset_without_token: build an AppendTokenDataset with no token to pass through the underlying dataset unchanged
test_AppendTokenDataset_getitem: test the AppendTokenDataset getitem method to verify token is appended to each retrieved item
review_AppendTokenDataset_sizes: review the AppendTokenDataset sizes property to confirm it increments each size by one when a token is set
summarize_AppendTokenDataset_num_tokens: summarize the AppendTokenDataset num_tokens method that returns the token count incremented by one when a token is appended
